editorial:
Imagine being so desperate for love that you would break a magical tree just to get a date. That is exactly what happens here. You follow a guy who thinks he is just a hopeless romantic, but he makes a huge mistake when he messes with the One Wish Willow. At first, everything seems like a dream come true because his crush suddenly loves him back. However, the vibe shifts quickly from a cute romance to a creepy nightmare. You can really feel the tension build as you realize the wish did not come for free, and something very mean is now following him around.

The acting is top-notch and the scary parts actually land well without being too over the top. While the middle part drags a little bit, the big twists at the end make it worth the wait. If you like stories about be careful what you wish for, you will love this one. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the creepy details in the woods, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: You find out that the wish did not make the girl love him, but instead replaced her soul with a monster from the tree. In the final scene, the guy tries to fix the tree to undo the spell, but it is too late. The monster reveals its true form and drags him into the roots of the willow. He becomes the new guardian of the tree, trapped forever to lure in the next lonely person.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark fairy tales and jump scares.
